parameters.question: Compare posterior Beta parameters (alpha, beta) and posterior mean binding probability for antibodies X and Y (Beta(1,1) prior; X: 41/60, Y: 33/60). Posterior alpha, beta, and mean must match the reference within +/-0.001. Any simulated P(X>Y) fraction comes from Monte Carlo sampling and may differ slightly (~0.01). Row/column order and naming may differ.

Two monoclonal antibodies: X has 41/60 positive binding, Y has 33/60. With Beta(1,1) priors, report the posterior Beta parameters (expected X: Beta(42,20), Y: Beta(34,28)) and the posterior mean binding probabilities, then report P(X > Y) from 10,000 Monte Carlo draws. Posterior Beta parameters must match the reference within +/-0.001. P(X > Y) must be within +/-0.05 of the reference, since it comes from random sampling.
